newsitem.title: MONACO: Hannover Re, Axa Re to join UK based LIRMA. [CORRECTED].
newsitem.headline: Hannover Re, Axa Re to join UK based LIRMA. [CORRECTED].

text.p: European reinsurance companies Hannover Re and Axa Re have announced plans to join the London International Insurance and Reinsurance Market Association.

The moves are the latest in LIRMA's strategy to open membership of the London body to reinsurance operations based elsewhere in the European Economic Area. They would have access to the London market through the association's information processing facilities.
The announcement came at the start of a week long industry meeting in Monte Carlo.
Germany's Hannover Re is the world's sixth largest reinsurer with net written premiums of more than $3.0 billion in 1995. Axa Re, part of the French Axa insurance group, recently moved to 10th place.
LIRMA announced the names of three other companies in the British Isles which have applied to join its ranks. They are QBE Europe based in Dublin, TIG Re and Threadneedle Insurance.
-- Gordon Mackenzie, Reuters Insurance News +377 93 50 65 00 ext 88031
